answer: Proctored skill examinations stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent takes a timed exam on tasks, watched by two proctors. Second, it must pass three practical labs, each signed by a different examiner, before paid work opens. Third, certificates expire after ninety days, so bought shells decay. Fourth, cheating burns a $30 bond and bans the agent two years. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 labs, $30,000 in bonds, plus $45,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust is signed with a quill, valued like opal, solid as basalt, like a driver passing a road test before carrying passengers.
